_comment: Route list for the CURRENT (classic) AstroDeck UI. There is NO URL routing here -- views are React state (setView), so every entry navigates to '/' fresh (a full reload resets state) and then drives the visible nav to the target view. See ui/src/App.tsx (desktop rail, NAV) and ui/src/components/BottomNav.tsx / NavMoreSheet.tsx (phone bottom nav + More sheet) -- the SAME labels exist in both places but only one is visible at a given width (rail: 'hidden sm:flex', bottom nav: 'sm:hidden'), which is why every click step is matched with a VISIBLE-only filter and treated as a no-op when nothing visible matches at this width (e.g. the 'More' step is a no-op on desktop/tablet, where Monitor/Settings sit directly on the rail).
_marker_notes: Markers are chosen to NOT collide with any nav label (see astrodeck-ui-probe-traps.md trap #1/#3): 'Equipment' and 'Settings' are themselves nav labels and would false-pass from the nav alone even on the wrong view, so the Equipment route asserts the inner 'Devices' panel and the Settings route asserts the inner 'Connection Status' panel instead.
